sources.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Eliciting Strong Capabilities With Weak Supervision — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 2312.09390v1 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors state that their setup still has disanalogies to aligning superhuman models. Imitation saliency: future superhuman models will likely have salient representations of human behavior, whereas their strong models may not have learned features for imitating weak models, so imitating the supervisor may be an easier failure mode to avoid in their setting, and weak model errors may differ from human errors. Pretraining leakage: pretraining data implicitly contains human supervision, so strong capabilities may be artificially easy to elicit.
title: Disanalogies of weak-to-strong setup: imitation saliency and pretraining leakage
